messages.Pe adiabata 1→2 volumul scade, deci \\(T: Along the adiabat 1→2 the volume decreases, so \(T_2=T_1\varepsilon^{\gamma-1}>T_1\). Along the isochore 2→3 heat is absorbed: \(T_3>T_2\). Along the adiabat 3→4: \(T_4=T_3/\varepsilon^{\gamma-1}<T_3\), and \(T_4=T_1\cdot T_3/T_2>T_1\). Therefore \(T_1<T_2,T_4<T_3\).

messages.Calculăm randamentul \\(\\eta_D\\) al ci: We calculate the efficiency \(\eta_D\) of the Diesel cycle in terms of the compression ratio \(\varepsilon=V_1/V_2\) and \(\rho=V_3/V_2\) (the preliminary expansion ratio, at constant pressure).
messages.Folosind legile transformărilor din tabe: Using the process laws in the table, show that \(\dfrac{T_1}{T_2}=\dfrac{1}{\varepsilon^{\gamma-1}};\ \dfrac{T_3}{T_2}=\rho;\ \dfrac{T_4}{T_1}=\rho^{\gamma}.\)
messages.Primele două rezultă direct din adiabata: The first two follow directly from the adiabat 1→2 and the isobar 2→3. For the third, divide the adiabatic equations for 3→4 and 1→2: \(\dfrac{T_4}{T_1}=\dfrac{T_3}{T_2}\left(\dfrac{V_3}{V_2}\right)^{\gamma-1}=\rho\cdot\rho^{\gamma-1}=\rho^{\gamma}.\)
